title: Add safe console editor for routing assignment
description: Build the issue-detail assignment editor on the resolved assignment API and write foundation. A human may select an allowed class or provider, inspect the effective model/effort/tier before saving, or clear an assignment. Preserve unrelated labels, reject conflicting assignment labels, do not mutate issue.agent provenance, and prevent unsafe changes for an actively claimed/running router package. Add confirmation/error UX and API/UI parity coverage.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Depends on kbs-fa8c60's resolved agent-assignment API contract, which just moved to Backlog pending a scoping decision. Moving this alongside it rather than letting the router burn an attempt on a dependency that doesn't exist yet.
